reason: The reported TypeError came from reading `.series` off an undefined `opts` at the sole `echartsInstance.getOption()` call site in the codebase, reached only via handleMouseOutRelease -> unhighlightMarkLines -> createMarkLineUpdater; the new `if (!opts) return;` executes between the getOption() call and that property access, so under the stated precondition (getOption() returns undefined on a disposed/uninitialized chart) the crashing expression is now unreachable. The follow-on guard `if (!series?.markLine?.data) return;` plus the optional-chained `?.find` also close the neighbouring undefined-series/markLine dereferences and prevent setOption() being called with `data: undefined`; evidence.affected_sites is empty and a repo-wide grep confirms no other getOption() site exists.
